source: 3. CTC breakup Calculator 50% Basic PF CELLING LIMIT-25000 01 OCT 26 (2).xlsx (CGB, sent 2026-11-06; replaces the first version's two structures)
notes: One structure per sheet: 'Without Gratuity', 'Internal' and 'External' (the 'Vizionforge' sheet is not imported). Each rule is the sheet's formula: Basic =CTC*50%; Statutory Bonus =IF(Basic<=21000,Basic*8.33%,0) (the BONUS wage type); HRA =ROUNDUP(Basic*40%,0); Transport Allowance 0 (the CONVEYANCE ALLOWANCE wage type); Special = CTC - the rest - the employer contributions.

Employer contributions inside the CTC: PF =ROUNDUP(IF(Basic<25000,Basic*13%,3250),0), ESIC =ROUNDUP(IF(Basic>21000,0,Basic*3.25%),0). Internal and External also keep Gratuity =ROUNDUP((Basic*15/26)/12,0) inside the CTC.

Gratuity is 15/26 of a month's Basic a year, 4.8076923...% of Basic a month. A rule takes four decimals, so it is 4.8077% rounded up: the sheet's figure or Rs 1 more (Special Rs 1 less) — exactly the sheet's for any Basic up to Rs 1,25,000 that is not a multiple of Rs 104 (Basic 26,000: 1,251 instead of 1,250); above Rs 1,25,000 about 2 in 100 Basics are Rs 1 more.

Employee deductions: Medical Insurance Premium 239 when there is no ESIC (Basic above 21000) -> INSURANCE; Professional Tax 200 on Internal and External (blank on Without Gratuity) -> PT_MANUAL. Employee PF, employee ESIC and TDS are left to payroll, which works them out each month (and prorates them for loss of pay).
